DML.SELECT:
SELECT et.element_type_id as "elementTypeId", e.element_id as "elementId", et.initial_element_type_state_id as "previousStateId", et.initial_element_type_state_id as "stateId", NULL as "maintenanceComment" FROM conf.elements e JOIN master.element_types et ON e.element_type_id = et.element_type_id WHERE (e.enabled = true OR e.enabled IS NULL) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM rt.element_states es WHERE es.element_type_id = e.element_type_id AND es.element_id = e.element_id )
UNION ALL
SELECT element_type_id as "elementTypeId", element_id as "elementId", previous_state_id as "previousStateId", current_state_id as "stateId", maintenance_comment as "maintenanceComment" FROM rt.element_states es
DML.INSERT: INSERT INTO rt.element_states (element_type_id, element_id, previous_state_id, current_state_id, maintenance_comment, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (:elementTypeId , :elementId , :previousStateId , :stateId , :maintenanceComment , CURRENT_TIMESTAMP , CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
DML.DELETE: DELETE FROM rt.element_states WHERE element_type_id = :elementTypeId AND element_id = :elementId
